html:
An Indonesian novelist, the country's best known writer, who composed the four novels of the Buru Quartet while a political prisoner on the island of Buru.

Born in Blora, Java, he fought in the revolution after independence was declared in 1945 and was jailed by the Dutch from 1947 to 1949, where he began writing seriously. Under Sukarno he joined a left wing cultural movement. After the coup attempt of 1965 and the mass killings that followed, the army of Suharto arrested him. He was held without trial for 14 years, most of them on Buru.

Denied paper at first, he told the stories to fellow prisoners. The Buru Quartet, starting with This Earth of Mankind (1980), follows a young Javanese, Minke, in the colonial Indies around 1900 as he discovers the modern world and the injustice of Dutch rule. The books were banned in Indonesia but translated into dozens of languages. He stayed under city arrest until 1992. He also wrote on the Great Post Road and its forced labour.
sum: An Indonesian novelist, the country's best known writer, who composed the four novels of the Buru Quartet while a political prisoner on the island of Buru.
